job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2025 City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System actuarial services RFP, not the OPERS investment consulting services RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: CITY OF AUSTIN EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM
Actuarial Services for an Actuarial Determined Contribution (ADC) Rate Defined Benefit Plan
Deadline for Submission of Proposals On or before 5:00 PM, Central Time, July 30, 2025
